tick_empty.description: Reference: fu_tick on an empty isolated world (REST off).

tick_bindings_64.description: fu_tick with 64 CapBinding entities (3 of 4 with one CapDependsOn).

tick_bindings_256.description: fu_tick with 256 CapBinding entities (3 of 4 with one CapDependsOn).

tick_bindings_1000.description: fu_tick with 1000 idle CapBinding entities. Goal: <= 50 us idle.

tick_splines_256.description: fu_tick with 256 unchanged CapSpline (24 points). Goal: <= 50 us idle.

tick_trees_256.description: fu_tick with 256 NativeTree (~1 KB XML) waiting in SimWait. Goal: <= 50 us idle.

tick_motion_256_parts.description: fu_tick with 16 motion loops of 16 moving parts each (256 parts with a second pose), all moving.

tick_motion_idle_1000.description: fu_tick with 1000 elements with two parts each and no loop or second pose: motion costs nothing when unused.

tick_places_idle_1000.description: fu_tick with 1000 free bodies in 10 ponds on a land and nothing changing: places cost nothing when idle.

places_force_edit_1000.description: One fu_set_component_json of the land's Gravity plus the tick that resolves the 1000 bodies below it.

places_crossing.description: One PlaceEntered or PlaceLeft event plus the tick that re-parents one body, with 1000 free bodies present.

tick_links_idle.description: fu_tick with 200 elements, 20 rules and 5 counts in a world that does not play: rules cost nothing when not playing.

tick_links_playing_idle.description: The same world playing, with no event and no timer rule: rules cost almost nothing when nothing happens.

links_touch_event.description: One Touched event that fires one rule with three thens, plus the tick, in the playing world above.

links_timers_100.description: fu_tick in a playing world with 100 elements of one kind with an every-0.5-seconds rule (a burst of 100 firings every 31 ticks, averaged).

view_changes_10000_static.description: One fu_tick plus one fu_view_changes with 10000 static views and one entity with Spin. Goal: 10000 static entities in at most 50 us.

read_views_10000.description: fu_read_views over 10000 static entities. No longer the per-frame path (fu_view_changes is); kept as a guard.

write_presented_10000.description: fu_write_presented acknowledging 10000 entities. No longer the per-frame path (fu_view_changes is); kept as a guard.

reload_script_6_entities.description: fu_set_managed_script reload of a 6-entity script with one value changed.

script_edit_900_entities.description: fu_script_edit on a 900-entity managed script. Goal: <= 1 ms edit commit.

tool_query_same.description: fu_query_json with the same expression every call.

tool_query_new.description: fu_query_once_json (uncached, no query slot) with a new valid expression every call. Goal: <= 3x tool_query_same (target is a multiple of that metric's ratio).

spawn_prefab_instance.description: Per-instance cost of creating 1000 prefab instances (one named child each) in one managed script. Since engine plan Phase 3 the child of each instance is attached to the kind's part when the script has run (about 8 us more per instance).

typed_read_bodies_up.description: fu_query_read_data over ~1000 bodies, cached query with three up-traversal terms.

handles_survive_unrelated_script_set.description: 1 when an unrelated fu_set_managed_script leaves a read [in] handle unchanged.

tool_queries_keep_feature_slots.description: 1 when 40 distinct tool queries (fu_query_once_json) do not force a feature query to rebuild.

source_apply_value_1000.description: fu_source_apply of a kind text with one changed value while 1000 instances exist (the edit commit). Instances hold copies of the built-in components, so the change is pushed to each one. Design goal: under 1 ms absolute (a ratio of 40 at a 25 us empty tick); not met.

source_apply_part_1000.description: fu_source_apply alternately adding and removing one part of a kind with 1000 instances (mean per apply).

spawn_1000.description: Per-instance cost of fu_spawn for 1000 instances of a kind with three parts (each instance copies the built-in components).

world_save_1000.description: fu_world_save_json of a world with one kind (three parts) and 1000 instances with one changed value each.

world_load_1000.description: fu_world_load_json of that document, replacing the loaded world.

sound_shape_1s.description: One fu_sound_shape call on one second of audio at 44100 Hz (size 0.7, rough 0.5). Runs on a worker thread in Unity, so the guard only catches a gross regression (about 2x the measured ratio).
